title: Hash Brown Potato
description: Hash Brown Potato is a classic continental breakfast side made from grated potatoes cooked until perfectly golden and crisp on the outside while remaining tender inside. This professional restaurant-style method produces a beautifully lacy crust with exceptional texture and flavor.

ingredients.title: Ingredients (Serves 4)
items: 2 tbsp clarified butter (or unsalted butter + oil mix for flavor & stability)
2 tbsp neutral oil (canola, sunflower, or grapeseed)
1 small shallot, very finely minced (optional, for aromatic depth)
½ tsp freshly ground black pepper
1 tsp fresh chives or parsley, finely chopped (for garnish)

instruction.title: 1. Prep the Potatoes
steps: Peel the potatoes and grate them on the large holes of a box grater.
Immediately rinse the grated potatoes in ice-cold water until the water runs clear (this removes excess starch and prevents gumminess).
Drain and squeeze out moisture thoroughly using a clean kitchen towel or cheesecloth—dryness is key to crispness.

instruction.title: 2. Par-Cook (for Extra Crispness)
steps: Place the squeezed potatoes in a bowl and cover with boiling water for 1–2 minutes.
Drain and chill in ice water, then squeeze dry again.
This step gelatinizes starch slightly, giving a restaurant-style crust.

instruction.title: 3. Season & Bind
steps: Mix the potatoes with a little salt, pepper, and optional shallots.
Optional: Add 1 tbsp flour or 1 lightly beaten egg if you want a more uniform patty, but purists use only potatoes.

instruction.title: 4. Cook
steps: Heat a non-stick pan or cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Spread a thin, even layer of potatoes (about ½ inch thick) and gently press with a spatula.
Cook slowly for 6–8 minutes per side, resisting the urge to flip too early.
The exterior should be golden brown, crisp, and lacy, while the inside remains tender.

instruction.title: 5. Finish & Plate
steps: Transfer to a paper towel briefly to remove excess oil.
Plate as a round or square portion, garnish with fresh chives or parsley.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Breakfast Plate: With poached eggs, smoked salmon, or classic English breakfast elements.
Fine Dining: As a crisp potato base for seared beef medallions or grilled fish.
Garnish Upgrade: Top with crème fraîche and caviar for a luxurious touch.
